setting_0.description: hj_reachability 0.7.0 on a uniform grid over the benchmark domain (2D: 500 nodes per dimension, as in the original runners; an even count keeps the NL_SLC singular origin off the grid). Values are reported every time_step_report; verdicts need a margin of margin_cells grid spacings. NL_SLC: the vector field is set to zero inside a disc of radius 0.5 around the singular origin; simulated trajectories from the initial set stay at |x| >= 1.0.

CP_LQR_FIN_REA_CONVERGE.reason: the target box has half-width 1e-3, far below the spacing of any feasible 4D grid over the domain (about 0.25 with 41 nodes per dimension)
